def evaluate_move(move, pieces, to_play):
    score = 0
    # checks
    if '+' in move: score += 5
    if '#' in move: score += 20
    if move.startswith('O-O'): score += 3
    # promotion
    if '=' in move:
        promo_piece = move.split('=')[1][0]
        promo_val = {'Q':9,'R':5,'B':3,'N':3,'K':0}.get(promo_piece,0)
        score += promo_val*10
    # capture
    if 'x' in move:
        # extract dest square
        import re
        m = re.search(r'([a-h][1-8])', move)
        if m:
            dest = m.group(1)
            captured = pieces.get(dest)
            if captured and captured[0] != ('w' if to_play=='white' else 'b'):
                val = {'P':1,'N':3,'B':3,'R':5,'Q':9,'K':0}[captured[1]]
